name: Collagen peptides

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: Enzymatically hydrolysed animal collagen, rich in glycine, proline and hydroxyproline, taken for connective tissue and skin. It is an incomplete protein and does not substitute for dietary protein targets.

systems.note: Taken for skin; the intended effect, evidenced in the dermatology literature.
Taken for connective tissue and tendon; the intended effect.

monitors.why: An incomplete protein taken in gram quantities contributes to nitrogen load.
